title: Refused
description: On stderr, then exit 2: the job refused to start: a setting that is not a positive whole number, a folder it cannot close to others, or, for --help and --schema, no published schemas beside it. Nothing was dumped or deleted.

kind.description: The program (or, for the bridge, the message type) that printed the line.

run.description: One id per invocation (for the bridge, per process), on every line it prints: a random (version 4) UUID.
